endpoint.grammar: One signed decimal value on the first completed line, compared by exact decimal value. In comparison tasks a valid number outside the displayed pair is an endpoint violation.
endpoint.completion: Observed newline or EOS within the generation budget
endpoint.decoding: Unrestricted greedy decoding with one beam

probe_design.gradient_unit: Retain arithmetic comparison means for the historical A reference, but B/C impose one independent linear inequality for each eligible native-context fork. Context-only rows have zero supervision weight.
probe_design.right_factor: Reuse exact source-hash-bound Phase III-M selected columns and fixed unit right factor. No supervision-dependent geometry discovery.
probe_design.fit_selection: Select exactly one close and one far dual-error family from authorized adaptation only; both opposing comparisons must each have at least two valid incorrect replay-qualified forks spanning both frozen wordings. All eight parent presentations must be valid. Every parent-wrong valid presentation in a selected family must have a semantic replay-matched fork; a missing, accepted-already or inconsistent wrong fork disqualifies that family. Rank families by descending weakest member fork count, then frozen family ID. Keep every eligible fork within the selected comparisons (at most16). Parent-correct presentations are preservation obligations. Missing a distance or quota gives HOLD.
probe_design.preservation: Use common original parent-correct adaptation and preservation-fit trajectories;128 cap. Prospective eight direction-aware anchors cover four groups and both wordings. Shared sample from A and a target-only feasible numerical preview, never from development. Positive measured margin floors and exact restoration apply; all parent-correct practice responses remain protected in actual full generation.
probe_design.uncertainty: Measure direction- and radius-specific adverse preservation residual on actual rounded candidates using calibration only, up to two passes. Candidate must meet measured target floors on its original native prefixes, measured positive preservation floors and calibrated buffered linear preservation constraints. Failed calibration blocks decoding. Local predictions do not authorize checkpoint retention.
probe_design.measured_slack: Every active sampled stored-precision decision must preserve the original greedy token and exceed the positive calibration floor. The hard complete-generation guard covers all authorized correct responses.
probe_design.norm_matching: Reuse deterministic ten-probe stored-BF16 norm matching with2% tolerance and .025 hardcap. Every proposal must preserve measured active margins, all required individual target margins >=tau=.0625, native identity and positive support. No preservation weakening for matching. Distinguish local left-factor norm from actual stored tensor norm. At most two direction-specific calibration passes. No unregistered replacement for a refused cell. Arm A reuses the preservation-constrained mean-direction solver per tested amplitude. Arm C solves the minimum-norm target-plus-preservation witness at the .025 local norm cap once per calibration allowance pass, then scales only along that witness ray in the bounded norm-matching search. Require every individual target and buffered preservation inequality after scaling, unrounded norm <=.025 and stored norm <=.025. No rotation/refitting except the two preregistered calibration allowance passes; no rescaling a witness outside the cap into eligibility. A missing feasible ray/radius intersection gives HOLD for that cell.
probe_design.practice_gate: Positive strict-comparison gain and repeatable semantic correction, zero parent-correct or validity losses on adaptation/preservationfit, actual valid rate>=.9, actual stored native margins for every fitted errorfork>=.0625, positive measured preservation slack, calibrated authorized BF16 norm/support and exact restoration.
probe_design.development_transfer_gate: Independently reload each distinct practice passer. Require positive strict comparison gain, zero prohibited regressions or validity losses, valid rate >=.9, and at least one newly complete truth-flipping family (eight correct presentations). Never refit using this partition.
probe_design.finalist_ranking: After development transfer lock one survivor by complete family gain, strict comparison gain, smallest realized norm, then lexical arm ID. Only this locked finalist may reach preservation validation or independent selection.
probe_design.data_boundary: Fitting receives only adaptation, preservation-fit and calibration. Development transfer is post-fit. Preservation validation and selection are inaccessible until the appropriate lock passes. Hidden is host-held. No outcome may become fitting data in this study.
probe_design.geometry: Exact pinned Phase III-M layer23 selected columns and fixed right factor, rank one. No right-factor optimization, rank change, alternate layer or additional family selection after numerical or behavioral results.
probe_design.deduplication: At most four unique full practice generation candidates: A and C at each of .0200 and .0245. B is numerical-only diagnostic. Identical rounded tensors share measurements. Refused states receive no invented behavioral outcome.
probe_design.pair_diagnostics: Record per-fork h,a,accepted set,rejected top token,native context,presentation metadata; retain comparison averages and pair cosines. Compute target-only and preservation-compatible minnorm witnesses and dual lower bounds independently; a bounded solver failure alone is not an infeasibility certificate. For numerical A-versus-B-versus-C comparison, separately solve minimum-norm four-averaged-comparison inequalities as A diagnostic, individual target-only inequalities as B, and individual-plus-preservation as C. The historical ordinary-mean A generation ray is not called the QP optimum. This extra A diagnostic adds no full-generation candidate.
probe_design.budget_reduction: Two families, four comparisons, at most16forks; A/Ctwo radii only and Bnumerical diagnostic. No fallback CtoB, no supplemental generation, no rank/layer/model expansion.
probe_design.target_fork_rule: Every selected validated incorrect fork must have both predicted and measured stored-precision accepted-versus-strongest-rejected margin >=.0625 under the unchanged original diagnostic batch context before full generation. Do not silently change target fork identity, accepted set or native prefix. Every actual response remains checked by full generation.

joint_solver.method: Hildreth nonnegative dual coordinate ascent over normalized constraint-row Gram matrix; independently recompute primal/dual residuals and conservative numerical norm lower bound
joint_solver.failure: Separate numerical dual lower bound above radius from bounded no-witness; neither establishes nonlinear global impossibility.

probe_design.all_eight_outcomes: For each fitted family retain all eight rows: parent/candidate correctness, fork margin when applicable, predicted/measured target margin, native tokens and first divergence, completed semantic answer. Parent-correct rows are preservation obligations, never invented target errors.

candidate_lock: No automatic lineage acceptance. Post-fit development transfer locks one finalist. Require separate preservation and selection gates before host-held hidden verification. A successful hidden result remains a research candidate requiring operator review.
study_question: Can every individual target fork in two opposing-outcome families coexist with preservation in the current fixed-right rank-one subspace, and survive BF16 plus full generation?
receipt_compatibility: Reuse trusted independently replayed Phase III-M worker/assessment/outcome wire schemas, isolated Phase III-O fit/stage lock identity binds this protocol and sources. No dynamic code from adaptation documents.
capacity_decision: Use measured obstruction after the frozen study. Fixed-right local target inadequacy: optimized_right_factor_rank_one. Target feasible but preservationconflict: optimized_right_factor_rank_one/selectivity. BF16failure: precisionaware followup without capacityclaim. Forkscorrectcompletionwrong: sequence_level_semantic_objective orrepresentation_probe. Practicecompletebut nofreshfamily: representation_probe/additional_data_diversity. Freshcompletefamily: existing independentgates. No implementation of these later mechanisms in this study.
